digest.component_or_area: Rich-text cutover and echo suppression / state-based conflict resolution
propositions: Cloud and DC live send paths must route through rich codecs (markdown-to-ADF on Cloud, wiki rendering on DC) with state-based echo suppression keyed on baseline diff rather than codec idempotence.

Lossy round-trip (decode ∘ encode ≠ identity) requires two distinct compares: emit side compares normalized local vs decoded remote; baseline side normalizes local via normalize_outbound then diffs against decoded baseline.
Concurrent both-sides edits on description keep local-wins semantics and emit outbound-field-conflict alert; baseline advances only via _advance_baselines, sole baseline writer.

Echo suppression loops are bounded by observing rich_sha (8-byte wire digest) and rich_reemit counter; at threshold RICH_REEMIT_OBSERVE_AT=2, one post-push GET overlays via merge_baseline, then baseline converges.
Origin-gating routes updates only when local ≠ baseline, so Jira-authored constructs (panel/mention/date) survive edit-free passes; rebar-originated change detection is persisted, not inferred.

Cutover is flag-gated (reconciler.rich_text_cutover: off|cloud|dc|both, defaults off) and degrades to plain-text ADF when marklas optional extra is absent, preserving reconciler engine's stdlib-only contract.
